messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the arch sync — we need to decide an interface for ingress fairness gating (soft-handoff + emergency squeeze). TL;DR: ingress should call a tiny admission API that returns a lightweight decision. Thoughts?
chris: +1 to a small contract. we shouldn't leak model specifics into admission. admission = traffic control only, not model routing.
ravi: proposed shape (informal): input: customer_id, req_weight, priority_hint, fingerprint, optional abuse_score -> output: decision (ADMIT | QUEUE | REJECT), max_qps, grace_window_ms, fallback_tier. Keep it protobuf-friendly.
sam: how does this behave during a global capacity squeeze? prefer progressive degrade: reduce max_qps per-tenant, then start queueing, then reject. avoid abrupt rejects unless abuse. :+1:
teresa: eng-security: abuse_score must be injectable in real-time (streaming score) with short TTL. we also want a 'soft_quarantine' action for high-risk but not-severe cases so UX can show degraded mode.
maya: good call. also need observability: admit.reason, admit.version, admit.latency, admit.score_sampled. must be traceable end-to-end for regressions.
chris: operational concern: admission should be stateless-ish. any per-tenant policy should live in a config store; admission reads config and keeps a cache. keep the runtime decision pure. no per-request policy blobs.
ravi: regarding backpressure loop: admission should emit a capacity_hint int (how many tokens/sec we think we can safely take). ingress can use that for local shedding. avoids tight coupling.
sam: rollout plan idea: shadow admit_v1 for 2 weeks, sampling 5% of traffic, compare to current router heuristics. then 10% gate, watch fairness metrics (p99 latency, fairness_violation_count).
maya: example proto sketch in case useful:
```
message AdmitRequest {
  string customer_id = 1;
  float req_weight = 2; // normalized cost estimate
  int32 priority_hint = 3; // higher -> better
  string fingerprint = 4; // client fingerprint for local heuristic
  float abuse_score = 5; // optional, 0..1
}
message AdmitDecision {
  enum Action { ADMIT = 0; QUEUE = 1; REJECT = 2; SOFT_QUARANTINE = 3; }
  Action action = 1;
  float max_qps = 2;
  int32 grace_window_ms = 3;
  string fallback_tier = 4;
  int32 capacity_hint = 5; // tokens/sec suggestion for ingress
}
```
chris: that looks fine. keep field count tiny. version the proto as AdmitV1 and make it explicit in headers.
teresa: also add audit fields we can log: abuse_signal_sources (list) and decision_reason_code for downstream analysis.
ravi: telemetry we should track: admit.decisions_by_action, admit.latency_ms, admit.capacity_hint_gauge, admit.fair_share_violations. these feed fairness dashboards and alerting.
sam: test harness: generate mixed tenant load, run shadow admit, and compute oom/fairness deltas. we can open a canary job in perf infra.
deploy-bot: CI: admitsvc/protos unit tests: PASSED ✅ (build 4821)
chris: i'll sketch the RFC and proto PR. want to capture interface boundaries (stateless decision, config cache, telemetry contract, rollback hooks).
maya: perfect — thanks. I'll open the PR with proto + rollout playbook + perf job instructions by EOD Monday. @everyone please drop any gotchas here.
